# Knows Lists — 《迷你测试》 (test fixture)

What each character knows, and in which chapter they learned it.

## 阿测

- Knows she was reborn (chapter 1 — she lived it).
- Knows the drawer was locked and the key is broken (chapter 1 — she checked).
- Does NOT know who wrote the unsigned letter (open — F02).

## 阿验

- Does NOT know 阿测 was reborn.
- Does NOT know about the unsigned letter (chapter 2 — he was not there).
